## 页面可见文字
- 标题：**Study visit**
- 表头/列：
  - **Assessment / Activity**
  - **T0 (Arrival → Intervention)**
  - **T24 (18–36 h)**
  - **T72 (48–96 h)**
  - **Discharge (or Day 7)**
  - **Day 90 (+/- 14 days)**
- 页脚标识：**Boehringer Ingelheim**

## 表格内容（X 表示在该时间点进行）
| 评估/活动 | T0 | T24 | T72 | 出院/第7天 | 第90天(±14天) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Eligibility & Baseline Data | X |  |  |  |  |
| Randomization & Intervention | X |  |  |  |  |
| NIHSS Assessment | X |  | X |  |  |
| Follow-Up Imaging (for Core Lab) |  | X | X |  |  |
| Blinded Modified Rankin Scale (mRS) Assessment |  |  |  |  | X |
| sICH, malignant cerebral edema, and any intracerebral hemorrhage Assessment |  |  |  | X |  |
| Collect Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) Only | X | X | X | X | X |
| Process Metrics Data Collection | X |  |  |  |  |

## 决定与行动项
- 页面未显示“决定（Decisions）”或“行动项（Action items）”栏目/条目；仅呈现研究访视时间表与需执行的评估项目。
